##### Project general facts

Reef 998 redefines city living with its exclusive Sunken Balcony concept featuring outdoor cooling, blending nature, comfort and innovation. This forward-thinking development offers smartly planned units with elegant finishes, where luxury meets value. With a building configuration designed to maximize space and light, Reef 998 is more than an investment — it is a lifestyle reimagined, offering residents a calm, connected community with direct access to key destinations.

Residents enjoy an exceptional array of over twenty lifestyle amenities designed to enrich every aspect of daily life. The first floor features an infinity swimming pool, kids' pool, kids' playground, jogging track, gym, outdoor cinema, zip line, BBQ area, yoga, co-working zone, crossfit, boxing, wall climbing, floating lounge, sunken seating, baja shelf, hammock forest area, and aqua gym. The roof floor adds cricket, padel court, squash court, skate park, multi-purpose court, and multiple seating areas. Every detail is crafted to inspire wellness, connection, and recreation.

Every apartment at Reef 998 is crafted with attention to detail, combining refined aesthetics with exceptional quality. Kitchens feature built-in appliances from Bosch, offering seamless performance and sleek German engineering. Bathrooms showcase sophisticated fittings from Grohe, a trusted name in premium sanitary ware. From high ceilings and expansive windows to carefully selected finishes and fixtures, each residence is a sanctuary of style, comfort, and practicality.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Land Residence Complex, this exceptional location is gaining recognition for its investment potential with growing demand, proximity to landmarks including Dubai Silicon Oasis, Academic City, and the Dubai Metro extension, and a wealth of community amenities. Shopping, dining, fitness centers, and recreational facilities are all within reach, while schools, parks, and healthcare facilities make it a family-friendly destination.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity to key destinations. IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Desert Palm Polo Club, Dubai International Airport, Dubai Safari Park, Downtown Dubai, Meydan Racecourse, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Frame, Dubai Creek, Mall of the Emirates, Jebel Ali Racecourse, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Islands, Palm Jumeirah, and Expo City Dubai are all within easy reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies innovation, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Land Residence Complex delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of affordable living, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can feel the luxury and live the innovation.
